products.title: Espresso macchiato

products.title: Americano

products.title: Cappuccino

products.title: Turkish Coffee
products.description: A rich and aromatic traditional coffee with a bold flavor and smooth, velvety texture.

products.title: Iced Latte

products.title: Tea
products.description: A warm and refreshing drink with a delicate aroma and soothing, comforting flavor.

products.title: Mocha
products.description: For all the chocolate lovers out there, a mocha is an easy favorite. It is a chocolate espresso drink made with steamed milk and foam.

products.title: Hot Chocolate
products.description: A classic warm drink made with chocolate and steamed milk. Rich, cozy, and especially good on cold days.

products.title: Coffee Cake
products.description: A spiced tea latte made with black tea, steamed milk, and warming spices such as ginger, cardamom, and cinnamon.

products.title: Teapot
products.description: A warm and refreshing drink with a delicate aroma and soothing, comforting flavor.

products.title: Watermelon juice
products.description: A refreshing blend of fresh fruits, bursting with natural sweetness and vibrant flavor.

products.title: Black Tea
products.description: Black tea is made from the leaves of the Camellia sinensis plant. It can be enjoyed plain or flavored with fruit, spices, or other additions.

products.title: Strawberry juice
products.description: An iced latte is espresso poured over ice and cold milk. Sweet syrup is optional, and it is also known as an iced cafe latte.

products.title: Iced Mocha Latte
products.description: An iced mocha latte combines a latte with mocha flavors, bringing together chocolate and coffee in a rich and refreshing drink.

products.title: Blended Caramel Coffee
products.description: A blended iced coffee with caramel syrup, milk, and ice, topped with whipped cream and caramel sauce.

products.title: Blended Mocha Coffee
products.description: A blended iced mocha with coffee, milk, cocoa, and ice, finished with whipped cream for a chocolate shake-like treat.

products.title: Orange Juice
products.description: Freshly squeezed orange juice served cold over ice.

products.title: Frozen Lemonade
products.description: Frozen lemonade is a refreshing summer drink that combines freshly squeezed lemon juice, ice, and sweetener into a cool, tangy treat.

products.title: Lemonade
products.description: A sweet-tart sparkling lemonade made with lemon juice, carbonated water, and honey.

products.title: Black CoffeeTest
products.description: Black coffee is as simple as it gets with ground coffee beans steeped in hot water, served warm. And if you want to sound fancy, you can call black coffee by its proper name: cafe noir.

products.title: Chocolate Dessert
products.description: A rich and indulgent chocolate treat with a smooth texture and deliciously sweet flavor.

products.title: Caramel Dessert
products.description: A creamy and indulgent dessert with a rich caramel flavor and a perfectly sweet finish.

products.title: Pancake
products.description: Soft and fluffy pancakes served with a touch of sweetness for a delicious and comforting treat.
